```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(agricolae)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(janitor)
library(gvlma)
library(performance)
```

```{r}
ponder <- read_excel("./data/Ponder_general_yield_data.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  select(plot, water, cultivar, rep, pod_yield_kg_ha, yield_7_percent_moisture_kg_ha)

ponder
```

```{r}

mymodel1 <- lmer(data = ponder, pod_yield_kg_ha ~ water * cultivar + (1|rep))

anova(mymodel1)

```
```{r}
# Residuals vs fitted values
plot(
  fitted(mymodel1),
  residuals(mymodel1),
  xlab = "Fitted Values",
  ylab = "Residuals",
  main = "Residuals vs Fitted"
)

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

# Normal Q-Q plot
qqnorm(
  residuals(mymodel1),
  main = "Normal Q-Q Plot"
)

qqline(
  residuals(mymodel1),
  col = "red"
)

# Shapiro-Wilk normality test
shapiro.test(residuals(mymodel1))

# Heteroscedasticity assessment
performance::check_heteroscedasticity(mymodel1)
```
